TOR.text: RJ Barrett (34.1 mpg, hamstring, re-evaluated in two weeks from 11/19) and Kawhi Leonard (26.0, knee) are out for Toronto; Collin Murray-Boyles (concussion) is probable vs MIL.

CLE.text: Evan Mobley (32.1 mpg, right great toe sprain) remains out, re-evaluated 7-10 days from 11/16; Jaylon Tyson (23.9, ankle) is probable at CHI on 11/23.

NO.text: Trey Murphy III (32.4 mpg, knees) and Zion Williamson (32.4, thigh) are probable vs PHX on 11/23; Dejounte Murray (ankle) remains out.

IND.text: Pascal Siakam (32.3 mpg, hip) is questionable vs OKC on 11/23; Aaron Nesmith (27.3) and T.J. McConnell are out, and Tyrese Haliburton (33.0) remains out.
